cleavage agent: subjected to an in-gel digestion protocol using trypsin for LC–MS/MS analysis
enrichment method: using coimmunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry to identify interaction partners
fractionation method: Eluate samples obtained after immunoprecipitation were separated using a 12% SDS-polyacrylamide gel
fragmentation method: the resolution of the higher energy collisional dissociation spectra was set to 17,500 at m/z 200
instrument: coupled to a Q Exactive instrument (Thermo Fisher Scientific, MA, USA)
ionization type: The Q Exactive apparatus with an EASY nanospray source (Thermo Fisher Scientific) was used to analyze peptides
labeling: Exponentially modified Protein Abundance Index (emPAI) was used for label-free protein quantification
